subject.title: feat(durable): add beta3 runtime core foundation

question: Should the repository retain this broad beta3 durable-runtime branch as a merge candidate, or formally retire it in favor of the owner-first implementation sequence after the RFC decision?
rationale: The branch’s persistence, lifecycle, and public protocol boundaries establish a durable product contract; the author and the open successor RFC both state that the ownership and migration model must be decided before a replacement implementation is submitted.

options.title: Retire after RFC decision
options.body: After maintainers choose the owner-first boundary, close this proof-archive branch and require narrow replacement PRs from that approved plan.

options.title: Sponsor a narrowed extraction
options.body: Select a small, owner-scoped subset of this work and request a fresh implementation PR with an enabled-only migration plan and explicit upgrade contract.

options.title: Keep this branch as the candidate
options.body: Accept the broad shared-schema durable layer as the product direction and perform a full owner, migration, and compatibility review on this exact branch.

recommendation.title: Retire after RFC decision
recommendation.body: After maintainers choose the owner-first boundary, close this proof-archive branch and require narrow replacement PRs from that approved plan.

likelyOwner.reason: The available timeline signal shows direct engagement when the prior review routed the persistent durable-runtime contract to human ownership judgment.
